name: Poproč (Košice-okolie District, Slovakia)
description: A red field with a yellow saltire edged in white, ending at the fly in three tails formed by two swallowtail notches reaching one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature P-36/94.
